scope: Version-pinned package/source contracts plus standalone runtime/module availability; not live MCP/SQLite/provider integration proof.
findings: 0.12.0 packages published and bundled runtime exposes node:sqlite; shell Node 20 does not.
Public plugin RPC/hooks do not register MCP Tools. Transport/auth is separate engineering.
Low-level plugin RPC requires daemon.manage and is not a scoped agent credential.
Timeout/reload/idempotency fields do not replace durable owner receipts/reconciliation/fencing.
